snippet.title: Dandelion Void - Teaser Trailer
snippet.description:
Follow development and sign up to playtest:
https://discord.gg/xJJ8Y6ptgf

A dozen generations lived and died aboard the starship Pergola. Yet still it drifts through the void, its cavities choked with overgrowth, its destination long-forgotten.

As a lost child of this perished civilization, you eke out a primitive survival inside mankind's greatest invention. But you are not alone. Loot relics, craft and improve equipment, and uncover the mysteries of your derelict home.

Attributions for this video:
https://www.dandelionvoid.com/attributions
